description: handle_call(:fetch_transaction_system_layout) returns the build_old_tsl_from_bootstrap stub (bare %{logs: ...}, no epoch/sequencer/proxies) before recovery completes; snapshot-on-subscribe now guards this (q67.4 audit fix 3b) but the fetch path still serves it. title: Coordinator fetch_transaction_system_layout returns bootstrap stub pre-recovery
